description.text: As you walk through the front door of the elegant Paige plan at the Vue at Evelyn, you'll be dazzled by an open-concept layout, designed to meet your daily living and entertaining needs. The long foyer leads to a wide-open great room, a casual dining area and a well-appointed kitchen-boasting a generous center island and a walk-in pantry. You'll also appreciate the versatile main-floor study, a covered patio and a convenient laundry room. Nestled in the back of the main level, you'll find a luxurious owner's suite-featuring a roomy walk-in closet and a private bath with dual vanities, a relaxing tub and a walk-in shower. On the second level, there are two ample secondary bedrooms-each with a walk-in closet-plus a hall bathroom and a spacious loft. description.text: Custom-built 2,535 SF home on .60 cleared acre with Lake Travis views from the covered patio. Utilities in place. Exposed wood beam ceilings with shiplap, barn door, wide-plank hardwood floors throughout. Open great room with full-width sliding glass to a covered outdoor kitchen: commercial-grade gas grill, stainless range hood, sink, mini fridge. Kitchen features a large island, dark quartz counters, and tile backsplash. Dedicated home office off the foyer with barn door, separated from the main living area. Primary suite with soaking tub, walk-in tile shower, dual closets. 2x6 walls, spray foam insulation, whole-home water softener + RO system. Lago Vista STR-permitted. Live here fully while building your compound vision on the remaining land. Current zoning allows for additional accessory buildings such as garages or living areas.
